walk.zh: 我踏着浪的节拍走上岸。
walk.en: I come ashore on the beat of the waves.
My tail slaps the water to keep my time.

walk.zh: 每一步都落在歌的弱拍。
walk.en: Every step lands on the weak beat of my song.

walk.zh: 水花在脚边排成一行音符。
walk.en: Splashes line up beside my feet like written notes.

walk.zh: 我拖着水做的裙裾行走。
walk.en: I walk trailing a skirt made of water.

walk.zh: 草叶被我踩得沙沙伴奏。
walk.en: The grass rustles an accompaniment under my feet.

walk.zh: 我走得很慢，好把高音留住。
walk.en: I walk slowly so the high note can last.
Coming ashore, I shake off a cloak of droplets.

walk.zh: 我的鳍在地上画着节拍线。
walk.en: My fins draw bar lines across the ground.

walk.zh: 转向时，我先唱一个转音。
walk.en: When I turn, I sing a little turn first.
Seawater slides off my back and back into the sea.

walk.zh: 我绕开石头，不打断旋律。
walk.en: I step around the stone and never break the melody.

idle.en: I warm my throat and try three notes.
This chorus is still one breath short.
The water is calm, perfect for long tones.
I count the rests with my tail.

idle.zh: 海风把我的音符吹散了。
idle.en: The sea wind scatters my notes.

idle.zh: 我低头看水里自己的倒影。
idle.en: I look down at my reflection in the water.
A bubble rises from my mouth and pops.

idle.zh: 我调了调喉咙里的水音。
idle.en: I tune the watery sound inside my throat.
A solo needs no one to answer it.

idle.zh: 我在等一个愿意听的耳朵。
idle.en: I am waiting for an ear that wants to listen.

idle.zh: 音符停在半空，不肯落下。
idle.en: A note hangs in the air and will not fall.

idle.zh: 我的鳍轻轻打着三拍子。
idle.en: My fins tap out three beats, softly.
The tide is out, but the stage remains.

idle.zh: 我把最后一个音压得很低。
idle.en: I press the last note down deep.

look_player.zh: 你站的位置，正好是观众席。
look_player.en: Where you stand is exactly the audience row.
The moment I open my mouth, you step back.
Do not clap yet; the ending has not come.
Can you understand a song made of water?
I lift my chin and give you one look.

look_player.zh: 你的影子挡住了我的光。
look_player.en: Your shadow is blocking my light.

look_player.zh: 我对着你唱了半个小节。
look_player.en: I sing half a bar straight at you.
You are not here to catch me, are you.

look_player.zh: 精灵球别拿出来，我正唱到高处。
look_player.en: Keep the ball away; I am at the high part.

look_player.zh: 我绕着你走了半圈，找角度。
look_player.en: I walk half around you, finding the angle.

look_player.zh: 你的呼吸声太吵，打断我了。
look_player.en: Your breathing is too loud and breaks my line.

look_player.zh: 我眯起眼，判断你是不是听众。
look_player.en: I narrow my eyes to judge if you are an audience.
Our eyes meet, so I change key.

look_player.zh: 我朝你点头，像谢幕那样。
look_player.en: I nod to you the way I bow at a curtain call.

tempted.zh: 谁在拍手，这节拍勾住我了。
tempted.en: Who is clapping? That beat has hooked me.

tempted.zh: 那边的笛声，我只听一句。
tempted.en: That flute over there, I will listen to one phrase.
The moment applause starts, my feet move.
I know this melody; it is an old song.
Does the thing in your hand make a sound?

tempted.zh: 我靠近，只为听清那个音。
tempted.en: I come closer only to hear that note clearly.
If the beat is right, I will follow you.

tempted.zh: 那声音像潮水，拉我过去。
tempted.en: That sound pulls me the way the tide does.
My throat itches to sing along.

tempted.zh: 别停，再打一遍这个节奏。
tempted.en: Do not stop; play that rhythm once more.

collide.zh: 我一撞，水花溅了你一身。
collide.en: One bump and my water splashes all over you.
Your foot is pressing on my tail fin.

collide.zh: 我的尾巴扫过你的膝盖。
collide.en: My tail sweeps across your knees.
Sorry, I did not see you when I turned.
One bump and my note goes off pitch.

collide.zh: 我一整身都是水，抓不牢。
collide.en: I am all water, so you cannot grip me.
I nearly knocked you into the sea.
I step back half a pace and start again.
That collision knocked the tempo apart.

mate.zh: 两个人唱，才算完整的和声。
mate.en: It takes two to make a whole harmony.
You take the low line; I will take the high.

mate.zh: 我从不与人合唱，除了你。
mate.en: I never sing with anyone but you.

mate.zh: 这一段，我想听你的版本。
mate.en: This passage, I want to hear your version.

mate.zh: 我们的音高刚好差三度。
mate.en: Our pitches sit exactly a third apart.

mate.zh: 你的声音让我的水音发颤。
mate.en: Your voice makes the water in mine tremble.

mate.zh: 潮水会记得这段二重唱。
mate.en: The tide will remember this duet.

mate.zh: 我靠近，让两个音叠在一起。
mate.en: I lean in and let our two notes overlap.
Do not drift off key; I am listening.

mate.zh: 唱完这支，海就是我们的。
mate.en: When this song ends, the sea is ours.

pickup.zh: 我衔起那颗会响的东西。
pickup.en: I pick up the thing that rattles.

pickup.zh: 这枚贝壳，我要拿来当铃。
pickup.en: This shell will serve me as a bell.
I pinch it with my fin and nearly drop it.

pickup.zh: 捡起来一听，里面全是海声。
pickup.en: I lift it to my ear; it is full of sea sound.

pickup.zh: 亮的东西，正好配我的舞台。
pickup.en: Something bright, just right for my stage.

pickup.zh: 我把它滚了滚，像颗水珠。
pickup.en: I roll it about like a bead of water.
What falls on the ground belongs to me now.

pickup.zh: 我低头叼起，喉咙里哼一声。
pickup.en: I lower my head, take it, and hum once.

pickup.zh: 这个，放进我的歌里刚好。
pickup.en: This fits into my song perfectly.
What I pick up, I will give back.

target_acquire.en: I found my opponent, so the light is set.
This one I will play as the finale.
I breathe in and raise the note as high as it goes.
You have stepped into the middle of my stage.
I count three beats and then begin.
The stronger the foe, the wider my range.
I bow my head first, then strike.

target_acquire.zh: 舞台清空，只剩我们两个。
target_acquire.en: The stage is cleared; only the two of us remain.

targeting.zh: 我盯着你，找呼吸的空隙。
targeting.en: I watch you for the gap between your breaths.

targeting.zh: 你的节拍乱了，我听见了。
targeting.en: Your rhythm has slipped, and I heard it.
A ball of water gathers at my lips.

targeting.zh: 我一步一步，把距离缩短。
targeting.en: Step by step, I close the distance.
The high note is ready, waiting for its target.
No rush; let me play you the prelude first.

targeting.zh: 你的重心偏左，我记住了。
targeting.en: Your weight leans left, and I have noted it.
I draw a circle around you.
This blow must land on the downbeat.
Do not blink; the climax is next.

melee_attack.zh: 我甩出一颗压缩的水球。
melee_attack.en: I fling a compressed ball of water.
A high note slams into your chest.
That one was for the audience.
I whip my tail fin across.

melee_attack.zh: 水花炸开，盖住你的视线。
melee_attack.en: The splash bursts and covers your sight.
The sound arrives first, my body after.
I crack the note and you go down.
This blow carries the taste of the sea.
I sang that one as an accent.
I finish and I am still standing.

spawn.en: I walk out of the surf onto the grass.
This grass is my new stage.
The tide carried me to the shore.
This is where I first test my voice.
The grass is taller than me, so I sing upward.

spawn.zh: 海还在身后，歌已经开始。
spawn.en: The sea is still behind me; the song has started.
The wind carries salt into my throat.
I shake off the water and stand firm.
It is quiet here, good for a solo.
I sing one line to test the echo.

spawn.zh: 阳光照在湿漉漉的鳍上。
spawn.en: Sunlight lies on my dripping fins.
I am here; the audience will follow.

generic.en: My note breaks and my breath scatters.

generic.zh: 疼从胸口一路窜到腰后。
generic.en: The pain runs from my chest to my lower back.
I steady my throat so the note will not shake.
A corner of my water skirt shatters.
I step back twice and breathe again.

generic.zh: 疼得我把高音唱成了尖叫。
generic.en: It hurt so much my high note came out a scream.
The boards of my stage swim before my eyes.
I bite my lower lip and make no sound.
I will keep this blow inside a song.
Do not rush; I have not finished singing.

fire.zh: 火焰把我的水身逼成白气。
fire.en: The flames boil my watery body into steam.

fall.en: On landing, the note comes apart.

drown.zh: 水本该听我的，我却沉了。
drown.en: Water should obey me, yet I am sinking.

explosion.zh: 爆炸把我的歌撕成两半。
explosion.en: The blast tears my song into two halves.

projectile.en: An arrow cuts straight through my melody.

magic.zh: 妖精的血脉也挡不住这一下。
magic.en: Even my fairy blood cannot ward this off.

starvation.en: Hungry, I cannot hold the long note.

lightning.zh: 雷声盖过了我的最高音。

void.zh: 掉出世界，连回声都没了。
void.en: Falling out of the world, even echoes end.
